mapper.select: WITH balances AS ( SELECT b.pay_due_dt,b.tot_amt-COALESCE(r.amount,0) AS balance FROM tb_bl_bill b LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_id,sum(rcpt_amt) AS amount FROM tb_bl_rcpt WHERE cncl_yn='N' GROUP BY bill_id) r ON r.bill_id=b.bill_id WHERE b.cncl_yn='N' ) SELECT COALESCE(sum(balance),0) AS "balance",count(*) FILTER (WHERE pay_due_dt < #{today})::int AS "overdueCount", COALESCE(sum(balance) FILTER (WHERE pay_due_dt < #{today}),0) AS "overdueAmount" FROM balances WHERE balance>0
SELECT count(*)::int AS "count" FROM tb_fi_tax_pay WHERE pay_yn='N' AND pay_due_dt < #{today}
